name: Acetabular Labral Tear
definition: Structural tear of the acetabular labrum that may cause hip pain and mechanical symptoms, often associated with FAI or dysplasia.

investigations.principle: Imaging findings must correlate with symptoms.
investigations.MRI: MRI/MR arthrography helps characterize labral pathology.

amber: Arthroscopy is selective for persistent symptomatic tears after appropriate conservative treatment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shroni/Vankshana pain phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Structural tear of the acetabular labrum that may cause hip pain and mechanical symptoms, often associated with FAI or dysplasia.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.
